Local copies of the site's front-end libraries so the course works offline (no network requests).
Sources: docsify 4.13.1 (core, vue theme, search), mermaid 10.9.1, docsify-copy-code 3.0.0, prismjs 1.29.0 (python, yaml, bash), katex 0.16.11 (css, js, auto-render, woff2 fonts), all from the npm registry.
Google Fonts (Roboto Mono, Source Sans Pro) are in fonts/; vue.css @imports fonts/fonts.css instead of googleapis.
